air_calibration.docs: The pmwcs3 probe can to be calibrated in dry/air conditions. The air calibration is a 30s procedure.

address.docs:
**int**: New I2C address.

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#in-some-trigger)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the pmwcs3 sensor.

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#in-some-trigger)*

new_i2c_address.docs: A new I2C address can be set (for multi-probes cases for example)

water_calibration.docs: The pmwcs3 probe can to be also calibrated in water saturated conditions. Install the probe into a glass of water. The water calibration is also a 30s procedure.

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x63`.

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*

e25.docs:
Electrical Conductivity, reference at 25°C in dS/m. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*

ec.docs:
Electrical Conductivity in mS/m. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
Soil temperature in °C. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*

vwc.docs:
Volumetric Water Content in cm3cm−3. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [PMWCS3 Capacitive Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/pmwcs3#configuration-variables)*
